description.fun: Fletchling's lovely song is actually a warning: this friendly little robin is fiercely territorial and attacks intruders without mercy. Its body runs so warm that touching it bare-handed can burn, and the heat doubles when it gets startled or excited. Its forked tail is shaped like the fletching on an arrow, which is where its name comes from.
description.guide: Fletchling is a Normal- and Flying-type bird Pokémon from Kalos, based on the Japanese robin. It is known for its beautiful songs, which are really warnings, and is very territorial despite its friendly manner. Its tail is shaped like the fletching of an arrow.
description.tagline: A sweet-singing robin that's warmer, and fiercer, than it looks

description.fun: Fletchinder hunts with fire: it sets tall grass alight and swoops on the bug Pokémon that flee the blaze, cooking them before it eats. The hotter the flame sac in its belly burns, the faster it flies. It was the first Pokémon whose English name ran past ten letters, a limit older games couldn't fit, which is why Feraligatr lost an 'o'.
description.guide: Fletchinder is a Fire- and Flying-type Pokémon, the middle stage of Fletchling's line. A flame sac in its belly lets it fly faster as it heats up, and it hunts by setting grass on fire to flush out prey. It fiercely defends a feeding territory several kilometres wide.
description.tagline: A firebird that torches the grass to flush out its prey

description.fun: Talonflame dives on its prey at 500 km/h, kicking first and grabbing with its talons before the victim can flee, and it can carry off more than 100 kg. Embers spill from the gaps in its feathers as it flies, and its wings are so fireproof that people once made firefighters' suits from them. It's based on the peregrine falcon, with a nod to the 'firehawks' said to spread wildfires to catch prey.
description.guide: Talonflame is a Fire- and Flying-type Pokémon, the final form of Fletchling, based on the peregrine falcon. It hunts other birds by diving at tremendous speed and scatters embers from its feathers as it flies. Its fireproof wings were once used to make firefighting gear.
description.tagline: A fireproof falcon that dives at 500 km/h
